ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to Chancellor's Scholars in the Campus Honors Program (CHP). However, non-CHP students may petition to take the class. Go to https://honors.illinois.edu/curriculum/ and complete the form entitled "CHP Course Request Form for Non-CHP Students. Send the completed form to chp@illinois.edu. The class meets twice per week: once on Thursdays, and a second time to attend performances and/or exhibitions at Krannert Center for the Performing Arts and/or Krannert Art Museum. Event dates and times will vary. Students must be able to commit to attending the events on the syllabus. Admission to all events will be provided without charge to students enrolled in the course. On Thursdays at 1:30 pm, the class will meet in Room 156 in the English Building, located at 608 S. Wright Street in Urbana.
